name: Exchange For Physical Trade
definition: Technique whereby a position in the underlying is traded for a futures position in the physical commodity markets.

OutsideIndex.name: Outside Index
OutsideIndex.definition: Unexpected divergence between the price behaviour of an underlying position or portfolio and the price behaviour of a hedging position or benchmark.

FairValue.name: Fair Value
FairValue.definition: Difference between the value of a future and the value of the underlying equities after allowing for the discounted cash flows associated with the underlying stocks.

ValueForFutures.name: Value For Futures
ValueForFutures.definition: Value of a futures position involved in an Exchange For Physical trade.

OutMainCountryIndex.name: Out Main Country Index
OutMainCountryIndex.definition: Accepted value of stocks composing an index located outside its country of origin.

SecuritiesOrder.name: Securities Order
SecuritiesOrder.definition: Order for which parameters for exchange for physical trading are specified.
